description: Opaque warm rust-red floor-length gown, with a low square neckline, a fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves decorated with gold-red floral borders. Fine matching trim runs around the neckline, cuffs, front skirt opening and hem. A narrow decorated waist girdle has a small geometric gold clasp and hanging trim. The cream underdress visible through the skirt opening has gold-brown vine embroidery. A matching red-gold wrap lies over one forearm and falls down one side, with broad patterned borders. A small pendant necklace and a brown closed leather shoe are visible. No armor, headgear or weapon is present.
